description: Driving and validating the Tethys-Chloris (T&C) ecohydrological model at forested AmeriFlux sites across CONUS ecoregions, to test how remote-sensing-derived dynamic leaf mass per area (LMA) alters simulated water, energy and carbon fluxes relative to a fixed-LMA baseline.
citation: Cite the individual site DOIs and the AmeriFlux data policy: https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/data-policy/
